The csv file Neuropathic_39.csv contains neuropathic pain diagnosis records in the form of tables of which the row represents different patients and the column represents different diagnostic labels.

Which cause-and-effect relationship is more likely?
A. L L1 radiculopathy causes L medical groin trouble
B. L medical groin trouble causes L L1 radiculopathy
C. No causal relationship exists
Please answer with A, B, or C.

a
b
c
